decision: Stage 4a is evidence preparation, not automated variable selection.
Model capacity is evaluated using approximate degrees of freedom, not only predictor names.
Predictors are grouped into clinical domains/families.
Statistical collinearity, soft correlations, and clinical overlap are reviewed as separate layers.
Timing variables are adjustment/sensitivity candidates, not ordinary main predictors.
LASSO/penalized regression may be used later only as sensitivity analysis.
Final model specs are generated only after explicit committee lock-in decisions.
Stage 3 DEC-059B is a prerequisite for Stage 4a.
Stage 4a includes missingness/n_model audit to prevent silent missing-as-reference errors.
Stage 4a outputs a committee lock-in template with blank final decision fields.
Stage 4a explicitly balances cardiology-prioritized predictors with data-informed discovery candidates.
v3.1: Candidate-logic hierarchy (core_adjustment / primary_echo_domain / outcome_specific_exploratory / sensitivity_or_timing / primary_clinical_supporting) documented per predictor.
v3.1: Outcome-relevance flags + per-outcome rationales replace any 'selected_for_outcome' framing; final include columns left blank.
v3.1: Lock-in template includes decision_basis, decision_reason_free_text, and reviewer_defensibility_note as required justification fields.
